why is my order delayed, how do I get a refund for a defective item, and why was I charged the wrong amount

Regarding why your order is delayed: The provided documents do not state why an order might be delayed, only the resolution process for domestic orders delayed more than 7 business days.

Regarding how to get a refund for a defective item: You must report the defect within 90 days of delivery and provide a photo of the damage. Defective items are eligible for a full refund regardless of the purchase date.

Regarding why you were charged the wrong amount: The documents do not explain why an incorrect charge occurs, only that such charges (excluding duplicates) are not automatically reversed by the payment processor.
